description: This file provides combinatorial utility methods including binomial coefficients, factorial computations, Stirling numbers, and combinations iterator within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: CombinatoricsUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing combinatorial functions such as binomial coefficients, factorials, Stirling numbers, and subset iterators.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Computes exact binomial coefficient (n choose k) as a long, with overflow checks.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Computes binomial coefficient as a double for larger values, may return Infinity for very large n.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the binomial coefficient, useful for handling large values.

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Computes factorial of n, returns long, throws exception if result exceeds long range.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Computes factorial of n as a double, returns Infinity if too large.

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of n! efficiently.

methods.name: stirlingS2
methods.description: Calculates Stirling number of the second kind, S(n, k). Uses caching for efficiency.

methods.name: combinationsIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all k-element subsets of an n-set.
